d: China’s trade surplus has climbed above $1 trillion again despite sustained tariff pressure from the United States and Europe. Chinese exports rose more than 35% year-on-year last month, driven by products such as solar panels, electric vehicles and AI-related equipment. China’s advantage rests on manufacturing scale, automation, a relatively weak yuan and extensive state support for exporters. But the export boom masks weak domestic demand. Car sales have declined for 12 consecutive months, home prices are sharply lower and Beijing has introduced subsidies to encourage households to spend.
